name: Xavier
about: Xavier (class 1049), Theurgist on Argentrock, who receives the stolen Focus of healing (return_focus, G[111:1]). Virtues topic (Honor, 2026-11-08): the promise to bring it back (mark xavier_promise; deed xavier_promise_kept).

topics.label: The stolen focus
say: The Focus of healing was taken from this monastery. It is not a thing we speak of to strangers. Yet here you are.

topics.label: I will find it and bring it back to you. I promise.
say: Then I will hold you to that, and pray to Stratos that you can keep it.

topics.label: I am sorry to hear it.
Your monks lost it. Why should I care?
say: Xavier's calm does not break, but something behind it closes.
Then we have nothing more to say to one another today.
